item.title: Anthropic Engineering Blog
item.description:
Anthropic’s engineering blog covers practical, implementation-level writing on building with AI — agent design patterns, evaluation methodology, and lessons from building Anthropic’s own tools.

A good source for grounded, non-hype thinking on why certain agent architectures work better than others.

item.title: Simon Willison's Blog
item.description:
Simon Willison writes frequently and specifically about AI coding tools — hands-on reviews, careful benchmarking, and clear-eyed commentary that cuts through a lot of the surrounding hype.

Particularly useful for grounded takes on how well a new tool or model actually performs at real coding tasks, rather than marketing claims.
